verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Dagster orchestrating third-party sync tools (Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt) as assets. Nothing documents Dagster itself performing incremental syncs or managing cursors and state for new and changed records. Delegating syncs to external tools is adjacent support, not the product's own capability, and the only partition mention concerns wiping dynamic partitions, not incremental replication.

support.subject: As a data engineer, syncs move only new and changed records — cursor and state management handled for me, not full reloads
